A [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] '''flying monstrosities''' that resembled miniature dragons inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="CSWE" /> During his time on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], [[Ben Skywalker]] speculated that these creatures could be mutated by the planet's water, which he hoped wasn't the case since he needed water to survive.<ref name="LotF:E" />
